build_TOOD_detector: build a TOOD task-aligned one-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head configs
run_TOOD_loss: run the TOOD detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_TOOD_predict: run the TOOD detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_TOOD_extract_feat: run the TOOD detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from input images
review_TOOD_init: review the TOOD detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
